verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a cloud storage and productivity product like Google Drive, but the evidence pack never documents one. The only AI-related item describes how a developer could build an AI agent add-on with ADK and Vertex AI Agent Engine, which is a developer building block rather than a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
